title: Deer eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Deer body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="22" ry="16" fill="#C68642"/>
  <!-- Lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="74" rx="15" ry="9" fill="#E0A96D"/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x="34" y="78" width="6" height="14" rx="3" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <rect x="46" y="80" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <rect x="58" y="80" width="6" height="12" rx="3" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <rect x="70" y="78" width="6" height="14" rx="3" fill="#A0522D"/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x="34" y="90" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5C3317"/>
  <rect x="46" y="90" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5C3317"/>
  <rect x="58" y="90" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5C3317"/>
  <rect x="70" y="90" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5C3317"/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x="60" y="48" width="10" height="20" rx="4" fill="#C68642"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="44" rx="13" ry="11" fill="#C68642"/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="48" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#E0A96D"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx="83" cy="47" rx="2.5" ry="2" fill="#5C3317"/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx="72" cy="41" r="2.5" fill="#3B1F0B"/>
  <circle cx="72.8" cy="40.2" r="0.9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx="61" cy="34" rx="4" ry="6" fill="#C68642" transform="rotate(-20 61 34)"/>
  <ellipse cx="61" cy="34" rx="2" ry="4" fill="#E0A96D" transform="rotate(-20 61 34)"/>
  <!-- Antlers -->
  <path d="M64 34 Q60 22 54 16 Q58 20 63 26" stroke="#D4A05A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M64 34 Q68 22 72 15 Q70 20 67 27" stroke="#D4A05A" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M58 24 Q53 20 50 17" stroke="#D4A05A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M69 23 Q73 18 76 15" stroke="#D4A05A" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="64" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#E0A96D"/>
  <!-- Snack: apple held near mouth -->
  <circle cx="86" cy="52" r="5" fill="#E63946"/>
  <circle cx="84.5" cy="50.5" r="1.5" fill="#FF8FA3"/>
  <!-- Apple stem and leaf -->
  <rect x="86" y="46" width="1.5" height="4" rx="0.7" fill="#5C3317"/>
  <ellipse cx="89" cy="46" rx="3" ry="1.8" fill="#4CAF50" transform="rotate(-30 89 46)"/>
  <!-- Smiling mouth -->
  <path d="M78 52 Q80 55 82 53" stroke="#5C3317" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
